question: Should OpenClaw standardize `openclaw commands list` and `inspect`, including the proposed plugin descriptor metadata, as its supported operator inventory alongside Gateway `commands.list`?
rationale: The proposal is coherent and supported by runtime evidence, but public namespace, schema stability, plugin API exposure, and Gateway convergence are durable product and compatibility choices reserved for maintainers by the RFC lifecycle.

options.title: Ratify minimal commands v1
options.body: Approve list and inspect with narrowly stable fields, explicit plugin-load failure behavior, and a clear separation from Gateway inventory.

options.title: Adopt broader catalog
options.body: Choose the distinct catalog namespace and explicitly own its additional audit, summary, and operational lenses.

options.title: Defer command aggregation
options.body: Keep existing CLI, Gateway, plugin, and node inventories separate until a stronger shared consumer requirement emerges.

recommendation.title: Ratify minimal commands v1
recommendation.body: Approve list and inspect with narrowly stable fields, explicit plugin-load failure behavior, and a clear separation from Gateway inventory.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the repository's RFC acceptance lifecycle and are the strongest history-backed owner for coordinating this product decision.
